name: City of Pineville Elk River Access
facilities: Boat ramp, parking and privy shown on the MDC area map.
description: City-maintained Elk River access under an MDC cooperative agreement. Reach the parking area from Rhine Road; use the developed launch, not the highway bridge.

name: US-71 Bridge (I-49) Access
facilities: Highway crossing; no public launch, parking or landowner permission verified.
description: HELD: the previous coordinate identified the I-49/US-71 bridge, not a verified launch. Use the separate City of Pineville access. A public road crossing alone is not evidence of permission to launch.

name: Mount Shira Access
facilities: Gravel boat launch and large parking area. Camping is prohibited. Restrooms and an accessible trail were not verified.
description: MDC access on the west bank, reached from Highway 59 north of Noel. Existing bank pin retained; the MDC area map confirms the launch layout.

name: Noel / Shadow Lake Access (Hwy 59 bridge)
facilities: No verified public launch at the highway-bridge pin.
description: HELD: the former pin was a bridge coordinate with no established ramp or landing rights. The historical Noel City Park access is on Butler Creek, not this bridge. Verify an operator landing at Wayside or River Ranch/Sycamore separately.

name: Sycamore Landing
facilities: Private River Ranch Resort campground with tent and RV areas, restrooms and showers.
description: A distinct campground near River Ranch in Noel. Operator map shows river access and a float landing; launch/landing coordinates and independent-boat arrangements remain to be verified. Campground business coordinates must not be substituted for an endpoint.

name: Cowskin Access
facilities: MDC boat ramp and parking at Highway 43. Camping is prohibited.
description: Public access on the lower Elk near Tiff City. A trip from above Noel crosses Shadow Lake Dam; no through-route portage has been verified.

name: Lanagan Access
facilities: City-maintained access on Indian Creek, not the Elk mainstem.
description: EXCLUDED from Elk endpoints: MDC identifies this as Indian Creek access. The former Elk snap was over 2.3 km away. Retain for a separate Indian Creek dossier.
